reuse.why: Changes the rule inside the existing range helper and routes the budget template, the one remaining direct caller of the range helper, through the existing getScheduledAmount.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the template's own op-based dispatch is removed in favour of the shared function.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts, which every client and server consumer of expected schedule amounts already imports.

scope.why: Only the helper, the template call site, tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: A clearly named single helper (getRangedAmountWorstCase) behind getScheduledAmount makes the next rule change a one-line edit.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All consumers of a schedule's expected amount go through getScheduledAmount after the change.

one_place.where: getRangedAmountWorstCase in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts, used only via getScheduledAmount, which forecast, posting, action sync, preview, budget template and all desktop-client sites call.
